These files apply to third-party dependencies, not BookMatch's application code. BookMatch remains unlicensed pending its owner's choice.

The following unmodified texts were downloaded on 2026-09-30 from Qt's official Qt for Python source repository:

- [LGPL-3.0-only.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qtproject/pyside-pyside-setup/dev/LICENSES/LGPL-3.0-only.txt)
- [GPL-3.0-only.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qtproject/pyside-pyside-setup/dev/LICENSES/GPL-3.0-only.txt)

See the root `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for dependency attribution and the remaining binary-distribution review requirements. These two texts are not an exhaustive collection of notices for all transitive components.
